title: Las Vegas Wine Tour Experience
blurb:
Welcome to Las Vegas Wine Tours! The FIRST and ONLY Wine Tour Experience in Las Vegas.

Our tour begins with every guest walking the red carpet past the red ropes to our luxury party bus where they are immediately greeted with a glass of champagne and caviar.

From there, guests are whisked to Vegas’ trendiest restaurants and wine bars for a themed tasting led by their Sommelier host.

Each tour unveils a unique theme at every stop. One moment, you’re in France, savoring a refined Burgundy with a perfectly paired bite. Next, an Italian varietal complements its regional fare, followed by a bold California Cabernet alongside a savory steak at a classic American steakhouse.

Each destination showcases a new world region and distinctive varietal.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
3-4 Stops
Curated Wine Flights
Commemorative Collector's Wine Tumbler
Personal Sommelier Host
Luxury VIP Party Bus
Wine Tour Passport for Tasting Notes
Wine Education
Delectable Lite Bites
Unforgettable Memories
